ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v4_repair_fix
ir.intuition: Replace unsupported ops.sign with safe sign implementation to preserve adaptive bias and margin scaling.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + eps
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_rank_var = mean((delta_rank - delta_rank_mean)^2) + eps
beta = 0.1 * sqrt(delta_rank_var) / abs_delta_rank_mean
sign_delta_rank = (delta_rank > 0).float() * 2 - 1
bias_dynamic = bias * sign_delta_rank * abs(delta_rank) / abs_delta_rank_mean
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * bias_dynamic)
weighted_margin = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + scaled_bias
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(clamp(biased_margin, -15, 15))
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + eps
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    squared_diff = ops.mul(diff, diff)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(squared_diff) + eps

    beta = 0.1 * ops.div(ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var), abs_delta_rank_mean)

    # Safe sign implementation: sign(x) = 2 * (x > 0).float() - 1
    sign_delta_rank = ops.sub(ops.mul(ops.clamp(delta_rank, min=eps).gt(0).to(lpw.dtype), 2), 1)
    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(bias, ops.mul(sign_delta_rank, ops.div(ops.abs(delta_rank), abs_delta_rank_mean)))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss
